sections_reviewed: Sections III–V, especially field-of-view and capture-rate alignment (PDF pp. 2–4)
title: DeepSense 6G: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Modal Sensing and Communication Dataset
summary: DeepSense 6G is a real synchronized multimodal sensing/wireless dataset framework. Its methods explicitly align differing camera, radar, LiDAR, GPS and mmWave capture rates using triggers and timestamps, and describe modality limitations.
limits: Dataset/method reference only. No dataset files were downloaded here. It does not automatically supply warehouse Wi-Fi packet/deadline labels, sufficient transfer evidence, or a data-rights clearance for a future application.
